scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('npm install --prefix Frontend', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); execSync('npm install --prefix Backend', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "Frontend,Backend" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Backend"
